identificationModule.briefTitle: A Phase I/II Clinical Study of SHR-1681 for Injection in Patients With Advanced Solid Tumors
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase I/II, Multicenter, Open-Label Clinical Study to Evaluate the Safety, Tolerability, Pharmacokinetics and Efficacy of SHR-1681 for Injection in Patients With Malignant Solid Tumors

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This study is an open-label, multicenter Phase I/II clinical trial to evaluate the safety, tolerability, pharmacokinetics and efficacy of SHR-1681 for injection in patients with advanced solid tumors.

interventions.name: SHR-1681
interventions.description: SHR-1681 for Injection will be administrated per dose level in which the patients are assigned.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Incidence and severity of adverse events (AEs)
Incidence and severity of serious adverse events (SAEs)

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Time to maximum concentration (Tmax) of SHR-1681
Area under the concentration-time curve from time 0 to the last measurable concentration time point (AUC0-t) of SHR-1681
Area under the concentration-time curve from time 0 to infinity (AUC0-∞) of SHR-1681

secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Approximately up to 5 years after the last subject enrolled.
